records.title: Fixture Trunk Column
records.short_description: Central synthetic block of the development fixture frame.
records.overview: Synthetic development-fixture geometry used to verify selection, visibility, and camera behavior. It does not represent human anatomy.
function: Acts as the central reference block for selection and camera-framing checks.
quiz_facts: The trunk column is centered on the midline at X = 0.

records.title: Fixture Head Block
records.short_description: Topmost synthetic block of the development fixture frame.
records.overview: Synthetic development-fixture geometry used to verify selection, visibility, and camera behavior. It does not represent human anatomy.
anatomical_relations: Positioned superior (+Y) to the Fixture Trunk Column.
quiz_facts: The head block is the most superior block in the fixture frame.

records.title: Fixture Arm Assembly (left)
records.short_description: Synthetic two-segment assembly on the patient-left (+X) side.
records.overview: Synthetic development-fixture geometry used to verify selection, visibility, and camera behavior. It is made of two geometry segments that select as one structure, and it does not represent human anatomy.
quiz_facts: Clicking either the upper or lower segment selects the whole left arm assembly.

records.title: Fixture Base Plate
records.short_description: Synthetic support plate at the canonical support plane.
records.overview: Synthetic development-fixture geometry used to verify selection, visibility, and camera behavior. It does not represent human anatomy.
anatomical_relations: Sits at Y = 0, the canonical support plane, inferior to both leg pillars.
quiz_facts: The base plate marks Y = 0 in the canonical coordinate system.

records.title: Fixture Core Node A
records.short_description: Synthetic inner block from the fixture-core bundle.
records.overview: Synthetic development-fixture geometry used to verify multi-bundle loading and selection. It does not represent human anatomy.
quiz_facts: Core Node A loads from the fixture-core bundle, not the initial frame bundle.

records.title: Fixture Ghost Node
records.short_description: Synthetic ontology-only entry; its geometry is not yet available.
records.overview: Synthetic development-fixture entry used to verify that missing geometry is reported honestly in the interface. It does not represent human anatomy.
